summary: Nightly updates keep running and bring every database change with them, and the database can be administered by a group.

new.title: Database administered by a security group
new.text: A setup step makes a security group the database's Entra ID administrator, with the environment's own identities as members. New deployments set this up automatically.

fixes.title: The nightly updater repairs its own settings
fixes.text: When the updater is missing its database details, it takes them from the Manager and keeps them, instead of refusing every release.

fixes.title: Clear message when the updater cannot sign in
fixes.text: The message names the updater's identity and the group to add it to. It still never rolls a release it could not check.

fixes.title: Database additions reach existing installations
fixes.text: Each update now applies the shipped database changes, so new settings are present on existing installations. An update that would remove data is refused.
